$sources: HK Code of Practice for Structural Use of Concrete 2013: Table 2.2 (γm), Table 3.2 (Ec), 6.1.2.4 (stress block, neutral axis depth), 6.1.2.5 and Table 6.3 (vc, the maximum shear stress)

sources.ultimate.gammaS: HK CoP Concrete 2013 Table 2.2: γm = 1.15 for reinforcement (BS 8110-1:1997 takes 1.05)
sources.ultimate.strengthClasses: HK CoP Concrete 2013 3.1.3: grades C20 to C100 (SAEngine lists C25 to C80, the range of the shear table)
sources.ultimate.relations: HK CoP Concrete 2013 Table 3.2: Ec = 3.46 √fcu + 3.21 kN/mm²; 6.1.2.4 and Figure 6.1: the rectangular block 0.67 fcu/γm over 0.9 x (fcu <= 45), 0.8 x (45 < fcu <= 70), 0.72 x (70 < fcu <= 100); εcu = 0.0035 up to C60 and 0.0035 - 0.00006 √(fcu - 60) above, entered as steps at each band's top (SAEngine form, on the safe side)
sources.ultimate.neutralAxisSteps: HK CoP Concrete 2013 6.1.2.4(c): x <= 0.5 d (fcu <= 45), 0.4 d (45 < fcu <= 70), 0.33 d (70 < fcu <= 100) without moment redistribution
sources.shear.tauC: HK CoP Concrete 2013 Table 6.3: vc = 0.79 (100 As/bv d)^1/3 (400/d)^1/4 / γm (γm 1.25) × (fcu/25)^1/3 with fcu up to 80 (BS 8110: up to 40); columns 25-40 as BS 8110 Table 3.8, columns 50-80 computed by (fcu/25)^1/3 from the 25 column
sources.shear.maxStress: HK CoP Concrete 2013 6.1.2.5(a): v at most 0.8 √fcu or 7 N/mm² (BS 8110: 5 N/mm²)
